product.description: Marile transformări socio-politice provocate de migraţia popoarelor în Europa la sfârşitul Antichităţii au fragilizat puterea Imperiul Roman şi implicit toată ordinea politică a Europei. Chiar dacă supremaţia pe continent a fost preluată de regatele germanice, cultura Antichităţii târzii, în special creştinismul, a rămas puternică şi a marcat Evul Mediu timpuriu. Simultan cu răspândirea creştinismului în Apus, în secolul VII, profetul Mahomed a fondat islamul în Arabia, o religie nouă şi extrem de eficientă din punct de vedere politic şi militar. În foarte scurt timp au luat naştere mari imperii islamice – din Peninsula Iberică şi Maghreb până în India şi Asia Centrală, cu centre precum Córdoba, Cairo, Bagdad şi Samarkand.

# Illustrated History of the World: The Middle Ages (Vol. 2)

Explore the profound transformations that shaped Europe and the world during the Middle Ages with this fascinating illustrated history. Volume 2 delves into the complex socio-political shifts following the end of Antiquity, examining how migrations and new religious movements redefined the continent.

## Understanding the Medieval Period

This volume provides an insightful look at the major historical events that occurred after the fall of the Roman Empire. Discover how the political power of the Roman Empire was fragmented by the migration of peoples across Europe, setting the stage for a new era.

The book explores the persistence of Late Antiquity culture, particularly Christianity, which maintained a strong influence throughout the Middle Ages. We examine the interplay between these cultural legacies and the rise of new powers that emerged during this time.

## From Rome to Islamic Empires

Dive deeper into the historical developments that defined this era. The narrative traces significant events, including:

*   The impact of Germanic tribes in taking over continental supremacy.
*   The spread of Christianity and its lasting cultural impact.
*   The emergence of Islam in Arabia during the 7th century, establishing a powerful new political and military force.
*   The foundation of vast Islamic empires stretching from the Iberian Peninsula and the Maghreb to India and Central Asia, with major centers like CÃ³rdoba, Cairo, Baghdad, and Samarkand.

This illustrated history brings complex geopolitical changes and religious developments to life, offering a comprehensive view of the world during this pivotal time.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: What is the main focus of this book?**
A: This volume focuses on the socio-political transformations, cultural legacy, and major historical developments that occurred during the Middle Ages, particularly focusing on the spread of Christianity and the rise of Islamic empires.

**Q: Is this a complete history of the Middle Ages?**
A: This is Volume 2 of the illustrated history series and provides an in-depth look at key events, including migrations and the formation of major historical entities like the Islamic empires.
